annotations.title: Year-end check of this year’s plan

description: Answers "am I on track this year" and "how much more can I convert before December 31" for a subscriber: this year’s plan (the same inputs as plan_this_year) against what was actually withdrawn, sold and converted so far. Give traditional balances as of the start of the year, or today’s balance plus what was already taken. Returns how tax, AGI and MAGI moved from the plan, the RMD still to take, and engine-computed options for the rest of the year: the plan’s remaining conversion, no more conversion, and converting up to each line, with the added tax of each. Read-only.

acaHouseholdSize.description: Household size for the aca line. Defaults to 2 when filing jointly, 1 otherwise.

cash.description: Cash available to spend, US dollars.

cashUsed.description: Cash spent so far this year, US dollars. Default 0.

convertAmount.description: Also convert this fixed amount to Roth, US dollars.

convertUpTo.description: Also convert to Roth up to this line; it must be one of `lines`.

filingStatus.description: Federal filing status: single, or mfj (married filing jointly).

fillOrder.description: Which taxable source to draw first. Default traditional-first.

harvestUpTo.description: After the conversion, realize long-term gain in the taxable account (sell and buy back) up to this line; it must be one of `lines`, usually ltcg-zero.

lineMargin.description: Dollars to stay under every line, room for dividends or interest that land late in the year. Default 0.

lines.description: Lines to stay under, highest priority first, e.g. ["aca", "bracket-12"]. Taxable withdrawals stop at the tightest line; cash and Roth cover the rest.

items.description: A line to stay under: bracket-N = top of the N% federal bracket; ltcg-zero = 0% long-term capital gains ceiling; irmaa-N = below Medicare IRMAA tier N (estimate); aca = ACA premium tax credit line at 400% of the poverty guideline.

nonQualifiedDividends.description: Non-qualified dividends, US dollars a year. Default 0.

otherOrdinary.description: Other ordinary income, US dollars a year. Default 0.

pensions.description: Pensions and annuities, US dollars a year. Default 0.

qualifiedDividends.description: Qualified dividends, US dollars a year. Default 0.

rothWithdrawn.description: Withdrawn from Roth so far this year, US dollars. Default 0.

socialSecurity.description: Gross household Social Security benefits, US dollars a year. Default 0.

spending.description: After-tax spending the year must fund, US dollars a year.

spouseBirthYear.description: Spouse's birth year; required when filing jointly.

spouseTraditional.description: Spouse's traditional IRA and 401(k) balance (joint filers), US dollars.

spouseTraditionalConverted.description: Converted to Roth from the spouse's traditional accounts so far this year, US dollars. Default 0.

spouseTraditionalPriorYearEnd.description: Spouse's traditional balance on December 31 before the tax year (IRS Pub. 590-B). Required at their RMD age when spouseTraditional is supplied; omit before then. Use the year-end statement, not the current balance; enter 0 if there was no balance, US dollars.

spouseTraditionalWithdrawn.description: Withdrawn from the spouse's traditional accounts (RMD included) so far this year, US dollars. Default 0.

state.description: State of residence, two-letter code. Leave out for federal figures only.

taxExemptInterest.description: Tax-exempt interest, US dollars a year. Default 0.

taxableBalance.description: Taxable brokerage account balance, US dollars.

taxableCostBasis.description: Cost basis of the taxable account; required when it has a balance, US dollars.

taxableInterest.description: Taxable interest, US dollars a year. Default 0.

taxableSold.description: Sold from the taxable account so far this year, US dollars. Default 0.

traditional.description: Your traditional IRA and 401(k) balance, US dollars.

traditionalConverted.description: Converted to Roth from your traditional accounts so far this year, US dollars. Default 0.

traditionalPriorYearEnd.description: Your traditional balance on December 31 before the tax year (IRS Pub. 590-B). Required at RMD age when traditional is supplied; omit before then. Use the year-end statement, not the current balance; enter 0 if there was no balance, US dollars.

traditionalWithdrawn.description: Withdrawn from your traditional accounts (RMD included) so far this year, US dollars. Default 0.

wages.description: Wages, US dollars a year. Default 0.

year.description: Tax year. Defaults to 2026, the latest year with published tables.

name: year_end_check

actual.description: The plan with what was actually taken.

disclaimer.const: Not tax, legal or investment advice.

openConversion.description: Options for the rest of the year, each computed by the engine.

additional.description: Conversion still to do this year.

taxOnAdditional.description: Total tax with this option minus with no more conversion.

plannerLink.description: Opens the Dipperfield planner with these inputs filled in; the inputs travel in the link fragment, which browsers never send to a server.

rmdRemaining.description: RMD not yet covered by the withdrawals so far, per account.

rmdRequired.description: This year's whole RMD per traditional account: you, spouse.

title: Year-end check of this year’s plan
